summary: Align the existing production company and one seed record to the 24-facility Cleveland Clinic outpatient sale-leaseback portfolio. Direct manager and property evidence supports Fengate and MedCraft as current joint owners, Cleveland Clinic as former fee owner and continuing tenant/operator, a September 2025 closed transaction, and separation from the distinct 16-facility Fengate-Montecito Fund IV portfolio.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Exact Fengate, MedCraft and LiUNA-affiliate ownership percentages and the deal-specific Fengate fund are not publicly disclosed.
The published roster identifies 23 of 24 facilities and does not expose the complete SPV/member schedule or one omitted facility.
Lease economics, occupancy and MedCraft's detailed operating mandate are not publicly disclosed.
